key_trends.title: Agentic AI in sales ops

key_trends.title: Meta ads ROI accountability
key_trends.summary: Growth owners demand source-wise conversion inside CRM, not exported spreadsheets.

key_trends.title: Revenue ops consolidation

key_trends.title: Human-in-the-loop AI positioning
key_trends.summary: Shift from AI replaces sales to AI runs repetitive ops until you need a human.
